function.name: _codestudio_create_module
function.description: Create an AICodeStudio module (full Vue3 + Vite project; better than the website module for interactive/component-based/router-driven frontends). Returns the new moduleId, which all subsequent _codestudio_* calls must carry. Scaffolding (App.vue / main.js / router etc.) is seeded automatically.

name.description: Module name, human-readable; also used as the script/API group directory name.
